# Fenced angle-bracket tokens

A fence is opaque: nothing inside it decides document structure.

```
<binary> version
```

Prose after an info-string-less fence.

```bash
<binary> doctor            # self-check, exit 0 when healthy
kapi run <recipe> --out <dir>
```

Prose after a fence with an info string.

~~~text
<placeholder>
~~~

Prose after a tilde fence.

<Callout type="note">

A fence inside a JSX element keeps the element balanced.

```console
$ kapi plugins doctor
<binary> ok
```

</Callout>

## A heading after the JSX element

- A list item whose fence is indented:

  ```
  <indented> token
  ```

- A second list item.

| Column        | Meaning                     |
| ------------- | --------------------------- |
| `<binary>`    | the plugin executable       |
| `<recipe>`    | the recipe path             |

Closing prose, which must be read as prose.
